main.description: List posts stored in a registered Gyoka feed. Supports pagination and filtering by post URI, CID, and indexed timestamp.

feed.description: Feed generator AT-URI. Required when cursor is omitted; must match the cursor when provided.

uri.description: Optional post AT-URI filter. Must match the cursor when provided.

cid.description: Optional post CID filter. Must match the cursor when provided.

indexedAt.description: Optional indexed-at timestamp filter. Must match the cursor when provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor that includes the paging position and normalized search conditions.
Opaque cursor for retrieving the next page with the same search conditions.
